purpose: Single bounded software fixture; verify end-to-end completion and retained artifacts, not predictive efficacy
hypothesis: The repaired maintained v2 runtime can train, validate, evaluate causal controls and retain verifiable artifacts within its existing finite smoke budget
data: bounded_periodic_field_v1; source/config/raw tensor hashes retained by runtime
independent_unit: one complete generated fixture, seed 101; owners nested within split; no inference from time or spatial points as independent replicates
selection: Same training run/checkpoint for all five controls; checkpoint by validation loss; alpha grid [0,0.25,0.5,1] chosen per control by validation MSE with smaller alpha on ties; test does not select anything
primary_acceptance: exit 0, completed within budget, finite retained data/predictions/metrics, source/config/data/artifact hash validation
metrics: pooled element MSE and relative L2 diagnostics; report all controls and persistence without superiority/significance claims
uncertainty: not estimated; one seed is a software diagnostic
cost: one CPU lane, FP32, one thread, two epochs, 120-second run ceiling plus 30-second shutdown reserve; zero paid compute
stopping: Stop on resource refusal, nonfinite values, source/config/data drift, training/artifact failure or budget expiry; retain failure, no outcome-based retry or seed expansion
